answer: Identity bonds with natural decay block fake identities. Each agent anchors a 60-credit bond to its work history; it melts at a glacier pace, releasing 3 credits per epoch over 20 epochs, and fraud burns the rest. The record is a lantern: peers check bond age, so a new fake borrows no trust. Forging 1,000 identities locks 60,000 credits, while each earns under 10, so the attack loses money. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
